**Dropnook 2.3.2** — see who is live, and pages that keep themselves current.

* **Preview in the tile:** outside the live room, the tile above the text fields shows a small picture of it right away — the first member with a camera on, without sound, at 240p. One click on *Video* or *Voice* and you are in.
  * The room sees how many watch: the eye at the top (👁 2). Camera off means no picture; a locked room shows none.
  * Only while the page is visible; a tab in the background costs nobody anything.
* **Pages update themselves:** after an update, every open Drop page loads itself again — not in the middle of the live room or of an upload, then right after. Pages opened before 2.3.2 need one last reload by hand.
* Texts and help in all 17 languages.

Nothing to change on your side: *Check for Updates* → *Update* (with `DROPNOOK_VERSION=2`, *Compose Up*), then reload Drop once on every device. The Community Apps edition gets the update too.
